channel.title: Pier & Point · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west)
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west) (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): Rec and Park's project page gives estimated construction from late 2028 and opening in early 2030, but also says the remaining parks are anticipated to be complete by 2028; OCII's November 2024 timeline shows construction from mid-2027 through 2028. All are expected dates. In August 2025 Rec and Park said a design team "should be selected by mid-October" (expected); no source read says whether one was selected.

item.title: Correction · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): Parklab Gardens and the Commons interim area: all future dates are expected dates and they differ by source. Rec & Park's page gives construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030, yet says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'; OCII shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion'; Rec & Park's April 2025 deck shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028'. Parklab Gardens' opening is known only from an August 17, 2018 Chronicle article that says it was 'opening Friday', and OCII's November 2024 slides place it on P15 in one slide and on P13 and P15 in another.

item.title: Correction · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): The map notes said the shape traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area; it is OpenStreetMap's whole 'Parklab' park strip (about 14,665 sq m), which contains both the Parklab Gardens and Spark Social SF areas, and it is tagged as a park, not a garden. The notes also said P15's concept matches Spark Social SF's use of that parcel; OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF and the community garden on P13 and Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens on P15, and the Workshop 3 deck dates interim-use pilots to P13 (2016), P15 (2017) and P12 (2018). The claim that a design team was selected through an August 2025 RFQ now says what SF Rec & Park reports: an RFQ was released and a team was expected by mid-October. The 'early 2030' opening milestone is relabelled as a whole-project estimate, with a note that Workshop 3 shows an earlier construction window. The map notes carry a dated correction, and the shape's notes and source description were corrected.

item.title: Added · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): SF Rec & Park's three community-workshop decks were added as sources for the interim parcels P12, P13 and P15 (OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update labels P13 as Community Garden & SPARK Social SF, P15 as Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens and P12 as the SFF Soccer + Fitness Court), each checked against the PDF itself. Community Meeting #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15; soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12), plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan: SF Rec & Park's Future Parks page later reported (August 2025) that a design-team RFQ had been released and a team was expected to be selected by mid-October; no selection is reported there.

item.title: Existing · Parklab Gardens & Mission Bay Commons (interim, west): Parklab Gardens (one interim installation inside the mapped Parklab park strip) is reported as "opening Friday" in an SF Chronicle article of Aug 17, 2018 that pairs it with Stagecoach Greens mini-golf; the article is a pre-opening report, so the month is approximate and no later source gives the opening day. OCII's Nov 2024 update labels P15 "Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens" on its people-counts map (PDF pp.17-18) but groups "P13 & P15: Food Truck Park with Outdoor Dining (SPARK Social SF & Parklab Gardens)" on a survey slide (p.31), so which parcel it sits on is not settled. Interim-use pilots on the Commons parcels began on P13 in 2016, P15 in 2017 and P12 in 2018 (SF Rec & Park Workshop 3 deck, p.15). (~2018)
